run_text_to_video_sd: run the stable diffusion text-to-video pipeline on HPU to generate videos from text prompts
run_cogvideox_generation: run the CogVideoX pipeline on HPU to generate videos from text prompts with tiling and slicing
run_wan_generation: run the Wan pipeline on HPU to generate videos from text prompts with distributed CFG support
generate_video_from_prompt: generate a video from a text prompt using the GaudiTextToVideoSDPipeline with custom inference steps
export_video_to_mp4: export generated video frames to an MP4 file using the diffusers export_to_video utility
